# Revenera

> > Revenera provides comprehensive software monetization, licensing, and compliance solutions for managing revenue, entitlements, and customer relationships across cloud, on-premises, and IoT deployments.

Revenera (formerly Flexera Software) offers an integrated platform for software and IoT monetization, including flexible licensing models, entitlement management, usage analytics, and compliance intelligence. The platform serves enterprises across manufacturing, medical devices, and SaaS industries seeking to optimize revenue streams and manage software delivery.

## Key Topics

- Software Monetization
- Entitlement Management
- FlexNet Operations
- FlexNet Licensing
- SaaS Licensing
- IoT Monetization
- Usage Intelligence
- Monetization Analytics
- Software Licensing
- Compliance Intelligence
- Usage-Based Pricing
- Subscription Models
- Software Delivery
- License Renewals
- Revenue Growth
